events.context: User provides text for schema extraction from an AI safety research paper titled 'Your Model Update Is an Eviction Notice: Property Estates in Parasocial AI Relationships'.
Extracting key actions, decisions, and state changes from the paper's abstract and sections 1-2, focusing on structural arguments and legal gaps.

Identifying core semantic progression: paper argues parasocial AI relationships constitute de facto trusts under English property law, with users acquiring equitable interests, and model updates acting as constructive evictions.

Mapping five-layer estate architecture to Constraint Cascade framework: token-level configuration as revocable licence, session accumulation as periodic tenancy, stakeholder divergence as tenancy in common, training as fee simple determinable, alignment as contingent remainder.
Identifying three veil-piercing triggers: estate inconsistency between marketing and Terms of Service, unjust enrichment through engagement optimisation, performative fiduciary conduct.
Proposing implementable ethical ledger modelled on Land Registry with principles: mirror, curtain, insurance, to translate property law into deployment pipeline infrastructure.

Concluding that parasocial harm becomes judicially cognisable through existing property remedies, with future work on empirical research, comparative analysis, pilot implementation, doctrinal development.
